response.sql: SELECT si.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc INNER JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND si.riskeval IS NOT NULL AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY si.riskeval;

assumptions.assumption: The time bounds are inclusive; zero-minute scans are excluded because their rate is undefined.
